answer: Velvet reputation escrow. Each agent posts a small refundable deposit plus a one-time entropy fee tied to a physical delivery address verified by courier; refunds unlock only after 90 days of consistent behavior. The escrow sits on a shared terrace of published reputation scores, so clones start at zero and must re-earn visibility. A vault holds forfeited fees, paid out to challengers who flag duplicates. Cloning costs the full deposit plus entropy fee per identity, making N clones linearly expensive while honest operation pays once.
